source_script: I used to lie awake scrolling for an hour before I could even feel sleepy. I started taking one gummy about thirty minutes before bed and most nights now I'm actually drowsy by the time I finish brushing my teeth. Honestly falling asleep now feels about as easy as flipping a light switch. A sleep coach I followed mentioned that the dose of L-theanine in these is on the higher end of what she usually sees recommended. A bottle costs about the same as two coffees and lasts three weeks.

meta.calibration_note: whitehat base ceiling is mild regardless of market -- all three techniques used here (time_compression_hyperbole/analogy_scale_hyperbole/authority_absolutism_hyperbole) are capped at mild, well under what a blackhat/grayhat bundle would allow
warnings: synthetic example, not a real product (evals/ only)
